Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and did anyone hear him first?
Answer me, or I take this to the principal.
Then end it, or answer me. Owen.
You keep asking me that. I keep asking who decided.
I'm writing that down. No answer on who decided.
